desc:
This is the synthesized sound of a walkie-talkie roger beep followed by the sound of a radio transmission being cut.
I once had a walkie-talkie that made this noise when an incoming transmission dropped; this is the same sound, made with Audacity.
The roger beep is a 2KHz sine wave.

GENERATING:
File > New
Generate > Tone (Waveform: Sine, Frequency: 2000, Amplitude: 0.8, Duration: 0.1s)
Select from 0s to 0.02s
Effects > Cross Fade-In
Select from 0.08s to 0.1s
Effects > Cross Fade-Out
Cursor at 0.1s
Generate > Noise (Type: White, Amplitude: 0.4, Duration: 0.05s)
Effects > Low-Pass Filter (Rolloff: 36 dB, Cutoff: 4000)
Select from 0.1s to 0.12s
Effects > Cross Fade-In
Select from 0.13s to 0.15s
Effects > Cross Fade-Out
Cursor at 0.15s
Generate > Silence (Duration: 0.5s)
title: Walkie Talkie - Roger Beep
